nodes.title: 01 · Story and book controls

widgets_values:
Leave the premise blank for a new idea, or enter your own. Choose the age range, page count and art style, then click Run.

Local Gemma writes and reviews the story. The workflow creates character references, the cover and every page with Flux2.dev, checks the results, retries failures and exports a readable book.
nodes.title: CHILDREN’S BOOK GENERATOR · V2.4 PREVIEW

widgets_values:
Randomize creates a new book. To resume, load the original job from History, restore its seed and set seed control to fixed. Completed stages and candidate images are reused with matching checks.

Output: ComfyUI/output/books/. Read book.html when complete, or review-draft.html to inspect ongoing/failed work and all saved attempts.

The original id/pages/metadata story contract is unchanged. Import story.json and the cover/page images manually; production plans and quality reports stay separate.
